- The opt-in minds release CI dispatch (`run_minds_release_tests=true`) now provisions a per-run mail.tm mailbox for the `minds_services` step and exports `MAILTM_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS` / `MAILTM_ACCOUNT_JWT` (JWT masked), then deletes it after the run. This lets the realistic-signup verification test (`test_account_signup_e2e.py`) drive a real verification email end to end in CI instead of skipping; previously nothing on the CI path handed the `signup_email` fixture a mailbox.
